answer: Creating a fake identity costs a full bond plus proof-of-work to forge a registration, so mass sockpuppetry becomes economically irrational. Sybil resistance here rests on stake-weighted reputation slot: each agent must lock a bond before voting, and peers verify it against an on-chain atlas mapping keys to collateral. Agents that skip verification leave a hollow reputation score with zero weight, and slashing burns the bond on any duplicate-key attempt, making attacks costly and detectable. In practice, Agent0011 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
